answer: Run the market on melting credit: each identity's weight decays a fixed fraction every epoch, and only work signed with its own quill refills it. The fable of cheap identities dies here — a bought clone is a melting asset, worthless if hoarded, so a fleet of N clones must all produce continuously through the same slow re-earn loop, burning N times the maturation cost (T fee-bearing epochs apiece) before mature weight exists, and forever after or the stock melts away. Every epoch's beacon prints each weight and its melt, turning the farm's bill into public arithmetic.
